description: This PHP source file defines a Drupal 7 migration source plugin class 'BlockCustomTranslation' for migrating i18n content block translations from the database. It includes methods for querying translation data, preparing rows, and defining fields and IDs.

classes.name: BlockCustomTranslation
classes.description: A Drupal 7 migration source plugin class for translating block content with internationalization support.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns a database query to fetch block translation data, joining relevant tables.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each data row by fetching the translation for the opposite property (title or body).

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Defines the fields available in the data source for migration.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Specifies the unique identifiers for the data rows, primarily the block ID and language.
